method.chromium: desktop Chromium through Playwright, 1280 x 900 px, scale 2; the page direction from the Storybook direction global
method.text: the text on screen is read from each visible character's box (a Range per character), sorted from left to right; light-DOM text directly, an input's own text through its user-agent shadow text; text that is transparent (color or text fill), hidden, fully faded or clipped is left out

method.sits: the text's left and right ends against its input's content box
